mechanism_summary: RoleBinding driver-portal/driver-auth-oidc-reader binds Role oidc-config-reader to a ServiceAccount named driver-auth-svc, a typo that names no existing account, so the real driver-auth ServiceAccount is never granted the Role's read permission and every API read of its provider configuration returns 403 Forbidden while the pod keeps running; the badge-photo-resizer restarts in the same namespace are unrelated to sign-in.
decisive_evidence: driver-auth log lines 'identity=driver-auth discovery=ok' followed by 'provider config fetch error: wget: server returned error: HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden' and 'login validation degraded: signing keys stale, rejecting sessions issued after the last key rotation', every 10s, from a pod that is Running and Ready; rolebinding driver-auth-oidc-reader with roleRef oidc-config-reader and subjects[0].name driver-auth-svc while the namespace's ServiceAccounts are default and driver-auth only; the pod spec's serviceAccountName driver-auth. Decoys: deployment driver-portal/badge-photo-resizer in CrashLoopBackOff on 'PHOTO_STORE_URL is not set' (badge photos, not sign-in); trailer-pool/pool-balancer Pending Insufficient cpu; fuel-tax/ifta-filer jobs Failed on a missing jurisdictions file.
remediation_summary: Point the binding at the account that exists: kubectl patch rolebinding driver-auth-oidc-reader -n driver-portal --type json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/subjects/0/name","value":"driver-auth"}]'; within one 10s poll the driver-auth log flips to 'provider config refreshed from oidc-provider-config' with no restart and no change to the Deployment, the Role or the ServiceAccount.
